lede: Wat Phra That Hariphunchai Woramahawihan accounts for 35 catalogued manuscripts, 3 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lamphun (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (97%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (3%). Dated witnesses run 1686–1945 CE (14 of 35 carry a date).
